summary: Owned sets accept agent exec/pty tasks, resolve ST_REVISION tokens, and read set membership in linear time

replay.detail: Existing owned-set receipts replay unchanged; membership reads are memoized per snapshot.

schema.detail: No persistent schema migration; owned-set.revised receipts may carry exec/pty member kinds.

rules.detail: Owned sets now accept agent exec/pty task members and resolve ST_REVISION tokens, refusing cycles and foreign tokens.

compatibility.detail: Pre-upgrade daemons refuse receipts with task members; publication blocks until every admitted fleet member advertises features.owned_set_tasks=1.

downtime.detail: No downtime; the feature activates once the whole fleet is upgraded.

recovery.detail: Until every member advertises owned_set_tasks, task-member publication stays blocked and existing sets keep working.
